value.rationale: The general theorem covers all n≥3 and all nonzero real Banach targets, not an isolated larger polygon. The uniform optimal kernel and Wasserstein contraction resolve infinitely many simultaneous constraints, linking Ptolemy geometry to a discrete inverse and positive cyclic factorization. Low-order n=4,5,6 values were previously available and contribute no separate novelty; the all-order bridge and proof supply structural significance.
